sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders are in outstanding form, having won their last four matches and drawing one before that. Alsager Town arrive as one of the division's struggling sides, lying second-from-bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and on a five-game losing streak, making this a fixture Sandbach will be heavily favored to win.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a stern test away at Dawley Town, with both sides capable of securing points. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in-form, host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a fixture between two competitive sides. Bilston Town, fifth in the table and also on good form, visit Foley Meir. Barnton host Shawbury United, who are in severe trouble with five consecutive losses and just one win all season. Market Drayton Town face New Mills away, with both sides needing to climb out of the lower reaches. Telford Town, second-from-bottom, continue their difficult run with an away trip to Cheadle Heath Nomads. Crewe travel to Allscott Heath in a clash between lower-table sides, and Widnes Town, pointless in the league, visit Brereton Social—all fixtures offer opportunities for sides seeking to push up the standings.
